notes: Vael (boss_vael). Built on templates\vael_template.flp (belfry_template + Gong & Timpani on sub_breath, insert 7): choir on Ah Voice (4), organ on Saint Eustache (harp, +12, insert 2), strings_ostinato on Staccato Blend (5, advance 0.06), timpani on Gong & Timpani (+1), bell_church on Clock Bell (timpani channel, insert 1, tenth notched per the Belfry review), strings_high on 12 Low Strings (brass_low, +12, insert 8, advance 0.12). v2: the timpani's +1 is keyed by its channel (sub_breath), since flp_build applies a transpose keyed by a channel name to any part on that channel (v1's bell sounded a semitone sharp); the strings_up PITCH knob moves ~1 c per unit (key 51 sounds +12 c on its harmonics, so -12).
